description: Imports a media file (video, audio, image) into the current Premiere Pro project. Target a nested bin with binId (a bin nodeId, unambiguous — preferred) or binName, which also accepts a "/"-separated path. An unresolvable bin fails without importing; the bin actually used is read back in the response as binId/binName/treePath. A file already in the project is reported with alreadyImported=true and is NOT moved into the requested bin.

binId.description: Destination bin nodeId — the unambiguous way to target a nested bin, e.g. the binId returned by create_bin. Takes precedence over binName.

binName.description: Destination bin by name. Use a "/"-separated path ("Scenes/Scene 008/SC008_0710") for a nested bin, or a single name to deep-search the tree (ambiguous single names are rejected rather than guessed). Omit to import to the project root.

filePath.description: The absolute path to the media file to import

name: import_media
